note: Neck-stretch staking care. All UI art is painted at 2x (draw at half the pixel size). Coordinates are in the PNG pixels unless marked display.

meter.night: none (sun/water/fertilizer meter cards have no night variant either)

stem.pivotNote: stem foot; rotate the stem around this point

head.howTo: theta = player head roll (deg, + = toward right shoulder, mirrored like a selfie). Stem: rotate theta around pivotInBox. Head centre = pivotInBox + armLength*(sin theta, -cos theta); rotate head by theta*1.15. Clamp theta to +-28.

hints.note: soft curved swoop + leaf tip; show the side the player should lean toward next; fade in/out, no text

ring.frameFor: frame = round(progress*11); frame 0 = faint track only (never shown as an empty failure state)

mask.css: .ring-fill{-webkit-mask:conic-gradient(#000 calc(var(--p)*1turn), transparent calc(var(--p)*1turn + 8deg));} over .ring-track; --p 0..1, starts at 12 o'clock, clockwise
mask.canvas: draw track; then ctx.save(); beginPath(); moveTo(cx,cy); arc(cx,cy,R,-PI/2,-PI/2+p*TAU); clip(); draw ring-full; restore()

ring.placeOverGuide: ring centre at guide box display (80,112): ring box left=-20, top=12 relative to the 160x220 guide box; draw ring behind the guide
ring.fps: driven by hold progress, not time

stake.drawLike: plant sprites: ctx.translate(p.x + offsetX*p.scale, p.y); ctx.scale(p.scale,p.scale); drawImage(img,-w/2,-base,w,h)
stake.offsetNote: sprite px right of the plot centre; draw BEFORE the plant so leaves overlap the cane. Use -56 to put it on the left.
stake.pick: tall for stage>=4 or tall plants (sunflower, tomato, cucumber, apple); short for stages 1-3 and lettuce/mint
stake.nightNote: drawPlants() already applies SPRITE_FILTER.night, so inside that pass draw the DAY file; *-night files are pre-darkened for places drawn without the filter

effects.anchor: same as sun/water/fertilizer: bottom-centre on plot (p.x, p.y-4), scale p.w/180, source-over blend
effects.look: loop: pale twine slowly spiralling up a soft green column with green motes and sparkles; absorb: twine wraps upward from the soil, sparkles rise, two little light-leaves tick upward at the top, then fades
